full_judgment: 2. The relevant fact giving rise to this Rule in short is that opposite-Party Nos. 1 and 2 as plaintiffs instituted suit No. 22 of 2004 for partition contending inter alia that the entire land of SA Khatian No. 42, 43 and 158 belongs to Bedon Ali Biswas. Bedon Ali Biswas died leaving behind the plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 and the defendant Nos. 1-4 and 6 as his heirs. The plaintiffs got 1.57 acres of land which has described in 'Ka' and 'Ga' schedule. The plaintiffs father lived at Nimtala. After marriage the plaintiffs have been residing at their husband's house and sometimes came to their paternal house and lived together. The plaintiffs have been possessing the land as ejmali. The suit land never been partitioned. In the last part of January, 2004 the plaintiffs requested to make partition but the defendants refused to make partition and the cause of action arose. Hence, the plaintiffs constrained to file this suit.
